title: Former Steelers coach Mike Tomlin reportedly to join NBC's 'Sunday Night Football' pregame show

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Sources: Tomlin joining NBC as studio analyst
sources.description: Former Steelers coach Mike Tomlin is joining NBC's Sunday night pregame show, "Football Night in America," as a studio analyst, sources confirmed to ESPN.

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Former Steelers coach Mike Tomlin reportedly to join NBC's 'Sunday Night Football' pregame show
sources.description: Mike Tomlin was coach of the Pittsburgh Steelers for 19 seasons. This fall, he will reportedly transition to TV as a studio analyst for NBC's 'Football Night in America.'
